title: When Calloway's Own Dates Hold Up Closing: Start of a Home Purchase Agreement Delay Period
content:
**Closing coordination rule.** For a closing delay per diem on a Home Purchase Agreement, the day the delay period starts depends on whether Calloway's own dates let the buyer close on the scheduled closing date:

- **(a) Home finished late.** Where the construction stage is complete and the home's estimated completion date falls after the scheduled closing date, the delay period starts on the day after the estimated completion date.
- **(b) Short notice.** Where the estimated completion date falls on or before the scheduled closing date and the latest closing date notice was sent fewer than the collection's minimum closing date notice days before the scheduled closing date, the delay period starts on the day after the date that falls that many calendar days after that notice.
- **(c)** In every other case neither of these dates moves the start of the delay period.

"Sent fewer than N days before" compares the number of calendar days from the date of the latest closing date notice on the agreement ledger to the scheduled closing date with the collection's figure N:

| Collection | Minimum closing date notice N (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Pathway Collection | 30 |
| Meadow Collection | 30 |
| Heritage Collection | 30 |
| Crestview Collection | 30 |
| Summit Collection | 45 |
| Reserve Collection | 45 |

## Condition table

| Construction stage complete | Estimated completion date | Latest closing date notice sent before the scheduled closing date | Start of the delay period |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | After the scheduled closing date | Any | Day after the estimated completion date |
| No | After the scheduled closing date | Any | Not moved by these dates |
| Yes or no | On or before the scheduled closing date | Fewer than N days before | Day after the date N days after that notice |
| Yes or no | On or before the scheduled closing date | N days or more before | Not moved by these dates |

## Bulletin examples (hypothetical dates)

- *Short notice, Summit Collection (N is 45).* Scheduled closing date 30 June; estimated completion date 20 June; latest closing date notice sent 1 June, which is 29 days before 30 June, fewer than 45. The date 45 days after 1 June is 16 July, so the delay period starts on 17 July.
- *Short notice boundary, Pathway Collection (N is 30).* A notice sent exactly 30 days before the scheduled closing date is not fewer than 30, so (b) does not apply; a notice sent 29 days before is fewer than 30, and (b) applies.
- *Home finished late.* Construction stage complete, scheduled closing date 30 June, estimated completion date 5 July: the delay period starts on 6 July.
- *Late but not complete.* Estimated completion date 5 July after a 30 June scheduled closing date, but the stage is finishes: (a) does not apply and, because the estimated completion date is after the scheduled closing date, (b) does not apply either.
